data_quality_warning: IMPORTANT, found by inspection 2026-07-28 (not documented by LINZ): despite sharing the 2025 3D Coastal Mapping campaign with sources/bathy/coastal2m, this layer is NOT a topo-bathy product the way coastal2m is. Its merged valid range never drops below -1.35m NZVD2016, and 35.7M of its ~57M nominally-valid underwater-looking pixels are the EXACT same repeated constant -1.20m NZVD2016 -- a fill/no-penetration sentinel (most likely the water-surface return where the laser never reached the seabed), not measured bathymetry. Smaller secondary repeated constants exist too (e.g. -0.825, -0.562). Do NOT treat (value != nodata) as bathymetric validity for this layer. build-depth-composite.py handles this by only trusting a cell where this layer AGREES with sources/bathy/coastal2m (2m LiDAR) within 0.5m wherever the 2m layer is also valid there -- real cross-sensor agreement, which transparently rejects the sentinel(s) without hardcoding their values. That gate leaves only ~1.9% of the grid eligible (vs the ~16.5% the raw nodata mask would suggest), i.e. this source ends up as a resolution refinement of coastal2m's own footprint, not a coverage extension into deeper water.
